data.content_ref: inline:The isolated node 1dced5d5a8ff shares mechanism with SRC_002 and SRC_001: all three derive the solution via the CRT residue class x≡18 (mod 35), and any divergence in the isolated node's answer (e.g., 53 or 33) must arise from a systematic error in computing that class.
